# Kinetix

> Kinetix is a product studio for apps, websites and AI systems, based in
> Kuwait. We design and build apps, multilingual websites and AI systems for
> established businesses in the Gulf. Projects from 750 KD. Every project gets a
> fixed quote after a short call.

- **Website:** https://www.kinetixkw.com
- **Arabic:** https://www.kinetixkw.com/ar/
- **Location:** Kuwait City, Kuwait, serving Kuwait and the GCC
- **Languages:** Arabic, English
- **Start a project:** https://www.kinetixkw.com/start
- **Freelancers:** https://www.kinetixkw.com/join
- **Instagram:** @kinetixkw

## What we build
- [Apps, websites and stores](https://www.kinetixkw.com/services/web-development.html): iOS and Android apps, from first version to launch. Websites and stores in Arabic, English and more, with payments, booking and real tracking.
- [AI systems](https://www.kinetixkw.com/services/ai-automation.html): WhatsApp agents and automations that take work off your team.
- [Brand identity](https://www.kinetixkw.com/services/brand-identity.html): Included when you need one.

## Proof
- Shahrayar: cost per lead from $16 to $4.40.
- Al Jadad: a course platform and app for a 124K-follower psychologist.
